[i][u][b]Opening Meet Between [nation]Oceanice Republics[/nation] and [nation]Pantagruel[/nation]
[/b][/u]

The President of the Republic, Vanklyis Herman, has open arms toward forming an alliance pact with the Pantagruel leader. The Oceanic Republic has invited the leader and a foreign diplomat from Pantagruel to come to the capital city of the Gate of Berlienwerk to sign a revolutionary treaty of trade agreement and alliance. 
 
Within the revolutionary treaty, open trade and market between nations would allow active exchange and deals in trading or selling to both parties, as well as limiting tariffs or taxes to 5%. For the alliance, Oceanice will open sales of its military equipment to Pantagruel, but with limited-off integration of full technology or equipment. Further, an official foreign building of Pantagruel will be constructed in the capital of the Gate of Berlienwerk.[/i]

[b]CHIQATI TIMES[/b]

[u]SFC 5 - YFC 0, CHIAQTI PRO LEAGUE[/u]

Since The Start of the Chiqati Pro League Yakhur FC has had a surprisingly bad season, Historically the biggest club in the country and 19 games into the season theyre 6th just barely in top half. Now they've dropped to 8th their lowest performance since the 1997 season. 

This Has occured due to a new manager with new tactics, which has confused many of the players, also due to a poor start to the season and having a bad season last year finishing 4th has heavily affected their morale.

In The Match against Sivachko FC (Currently 2nd) The Result was a surprise to The Yakhur Manager Edaven Yakhvatno. 
-Its Absolutely Insane How we Lost 5-0, we're the best team in this coutnry with the most titles and look at us, being beat by a team who finished in 6th last year. Said Edaven while at a press conference after the game.

During the Match 16 year old Wonderkid Zuzer Enárvek scored a brace against them and the 36 year old Club Legend Ukhzav Edgrod Still performing consistent seasons for the last 8 years scoring another brace against Yakhur FC while Winger Yughavuy Äkile Scoring the Last goal in the 90th Minute.

-Im Happy With My Brace against Yakhur, im really proud being so consistent at 36 scoring 4 in 2 matches is not someone of my age is gonna do. Said Edgrod After a Post-Match Interview.

The ULR is excited to announce a renegotiation of a deal with Nordiheim! Learn more about it here:
[spoiler=[b]Nordiheim and Lavia Trade and Resource deal of 24th of August 2025[/b]][b][u]The Burning Gun Deal[/u][/b]

[b]Trade and resource deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The United Lavian Republic[/b]
[i]====================================================[/i]

[i][u]With this trade deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Lavia agree to adhere to the following points:[/u][/i]
[i][u]_G__________________________________U____________________________________N_[/u][/i]
[b][u]Weapons Amendment and Vehicle Purchase Section[/u][/b][/align]
[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees to an amendment to the old agreement were Lavia was given license permission to domesticaly produce the 'MG Mk.1E'.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] Lavia will now be allowed the license permission to domesticaly produce the newer and improved 'MG Mk.2' of both the 'L' and 'M' variants.

[u][b]1.c:[/b][/u] Lavia will pay Nordiheim an anual amount based on the number of 'MG Mk.2' produced by them.

[b][u]1.d:[/u][/b] Lavia will not be allowed to sell, give or donate the 'MG Mk.2' to other nations without first getting permission from the council of Nordiheim with the exeption of active members of the EEHP.

[b][u]2.a:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will buy 100 units of the military vehicle MRAV Cougar(6x6) together with spare parts for the vehicles from the Lavian company Ijesa Dynamics.

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] Lavia agrees to allow Nordiheim easy access to buy aditional MRAV Cougar(6x6) and spare/replacment parts for this vehicle.

[b][u]2.c:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will not be allowed to sell, give or donate any MRAV Cougar(6x6) to other nations without first getting permission from the Lavian goverment with the exeption of active memebers of the EEHP.

+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++
[b][u]Resource Section.[/u][/b][/align]
[u][b]3.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim opens its resource market for Coal and Uranium to Lavia for them to buy these resourses with currency of equal value from the large Nordiheimian mining company 'Vestland Gruver N.A.S.'

[b][u]3.b:[/u][/b] Lavia opens its resource market for Oil to Nordiheim for them to buy these resourses with currency of equal value from the Lavian oil companies 'Puy-Dôme Petrochemicals' and 'CaneCantal'.

[u][b]3.c:[/b][/u] The Value of the Coal, Uranium and Oil will be based on world market prices that will be agreed on in quarterly intervalls together with the quantities of each resource.

+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++
[b][u]Civilian Section.[/u][/b]
[b][u]4.a:[/u][/b] Both nations markets shall become open to each other for the flow and trade of general goods, luxury goods and services to encourage economic growth and prosperity.

[b][u]4.b:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will be allowed to buy rice, cocoa and cocoa products, coffee beans, sugarcane, corn, and peppers from the Lavia agriculture sector.

[b][u]4.c:[/u][/b] Lavia will be allowed to buy from Nordiheims large range of fish, fruit and exotic fruits both in prosessed food products and as raw produce/ingredients.

[b][u]4.d:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will be permited to buy Lavias high quality Natural Latex for use in its industries.

[b][u]4.e:[/u][/b] Neither nation are allowed to place tarifs or special taxes on goods or services from the other nation without both nations coming together to discuss and reach a mutual agreement of understanding and consent.

+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++
[b][u]Promotion of Cooperation.[/u][/b]
[b][u]5:[/u][/b] In the interest of cooperation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Lavia be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticeable effect on the original intention of 'The Burning Gun Deal' as long as both parties can arive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++

[i]Signatory parties[/i]

+++++++++++++++++[u][i]The Council of The United Regions of [nation]Nordiheim[/nation][/i][/u] ++the two nations great signatories+++++++[u][i]Representative Minister Wallace H. Achebe of The United Lavian Republic[/i][/u][/spoiler]
